📄 Complete Details & Notification

SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026 is out. The Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) released the marks of candidates who appeared in the Written Examination (CBT) for the post of Head Constable (Ministerial)-2020 through a notice dated 14 October 2026. Candidates can log in with their SSB Roll Number and User Password on the official recruitment website to view and download their marks. The marks link stays active only from 14 October 2026 (11:30 AM) to 24 October 2026 (11:30 AM).

Direct Link to Check SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026

SSB Head Constable Ministerial Result 2026 - Quick Overview

Particular Details
Organisation Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB), Ministry of Home Affairs
Post Head Constable (Ministerial)-2020
Advertisement No. 338/RC/SSB/HC(Min)/2020
Notice No. 409/RC/SSB/CBT/2026/Vol-VI/6291
Stage Result Declared Written Examination (Computer Based Test)
CBT Exam Date 07 July 2026
Marks Release Date 14 October 2026
Marks Link Valid Till 24 October 2026, 11:30 AM
Login Details Required SSB Roll Number and User Password
Next Stage Skill Test (Typing Test)
Official Website recruitment.ssb.gov.in

SSB HC Ministerial CBT Result 2026: Important Dates

The CBT was held on 07 July 2026, and the marks were released more than three months later, on 14 October 2026. The dates below come from the recruitment notice.

Event Date
Online Application Start 24 July 2021
Last Date to Apply 22 August 2021
CBT Exam Date Notice 09 June 2026
CBT Exam Date 07 July 2026
CBT Marks Released 14 October 2026
Marks Link Active Till 24 October 2026 (11:30 AM)
Skill Test (Typing Test) Date Not announced yet
Skill Test Admit Card Not released yet

How to Check SSB HC Ministerial CBT Marks 2026

The marks are available online. Follow these steps to view and download them.

  1. Open the official website, https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/.
  2. Click the link titled “Marks of the candidates in the written examination (CBT) for the post of HC(Min) – 2020 held on 07.07.2026”.
  3. On the login page, enter your SSB Roll Number.
  4. Enter your User Password.
  5. Click Login.
  6. Your CBT marks will appear on the screen.
  7. Download the marks and keep a printout for future reference.

Also Read: UCO Bank Apprentice Syllabus 2026

Details to Verify on Your Marks Page

Check the following details as soon as the page opens. If anything looks wrong, contact SSB through the official website.

  • Candidate name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Marks obtained in CBT
  • Qualifying status

SSB HC Ministerial Skill Test (Typing Test) 2026

The Skill Test (Typing Test) is the next stage. According to the notice, SSB will shortlist or call candidates for this stage only up to 15 times the number of vacancies in each category, as per the instructions in the recruitment advertisement.

Particular Details
Who will be called Candidates shortlisted up to 15 times the vacancies in each category
Stage Skill Test (Typing Test)
Skill Test Date Not available. SSB has not announced it yet
Admit Card Not available. To be released later
Typing speed requirement Not available in the notice referred to for this article

What “15 Times the Vacancies” Means

The shortlisting is done category-wise. As a purely illustrative example, if a category had 10 vacancies, up to 150 candidates in that category could be called for the Skill Test. This is only an example of the arithmetic and does not show the actual vacancy numbers.

SSB HC Ministerial Selection Process 2026

The recruitment follows these stages in order:

  1. Written Examination (CBT) – completed, marks released
  2. Skill Test (Typing Test)
  3. Documentation
  4. Physical Standard Test (PST)
  5. Detailed Medical Examination (DME)
  6. Final Merit List
  7. Provisional Selection

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The marks link is active only until 24 October 2026, 11:30 AM. Download your marks before it closes.
  • Keep your SSB Roll Number and User Password ready before logging in.
  • Use only the official website, recruitment.ssb.gov.in, to access your marks.
  • Save a PDF copy and take a printout of your marks.
  • Keep checking the official website for the Skill Test (Typing Test) date and admit card.

Is the GSSSB Gujarati Stenographer Result Out?

Yes. The board released the provisional result on 13 October 2026. The notice states that the seat-number-wise list of marks obtained in the Main Examination is attached as Annexure-A. Candidates should check their own marks in that list.

How to Check GSSSB Gujarati Stenographer Result 2026

  1. Open the official GSSSB result page: https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in/ResultList.
  2. Find the notice for Advertisement No. 254/202425, Gujarati Stenographer, Grade-II.
  3. Open the notice and the attached Annexure-A (a PDF of 37 pages).
  4. Search for your 9-digit roll number (it begins with 254) or your name. On a computer, pressing Ctrl+F inside the PDF is the quickest way.
  5. Read your Paper-1 marks, Paper-2 marks and total marks in the same row.
  6. Download or save the PDF for your records.

Also Read: OSSC CGLRE CV Schedule 2026

What Does the Annexure-A Marks List Show?

Each row in the list contains the following details for a candidate:

  • Serial number and roll number
  • Name and date of birth
  • Gender
  • Caste category (for example General, General (EWS), SEBC, SC, ST)
  • PH group, Ex-Serviceman, Sports and Widow columns, marked where applicable
  • Marks obtained in Paper-1 (out of 100)
  • Marks obtained in Paper-2 (out of 100)
  • Total marks (out of 200)

Exam Pattern: Paper-1 and Paper-2

Paper Maximum marks What the notice says
Paper-1 (Prashnapatra-1) 100 Main examination paper
Paper-2 (Prashnapatra-2) 100 Skill test. The paragraphs typed by candidates are published separately on the board's website.
Total 200 Total marks are shown in the last column of Annexure-A

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The result is provisional. The title of the list itself calls it a provisional result.
  • The list is arranged by seat number, not by rank. A higher position in the list does not mean a higher merit position.
  • Typed paragraph details for Paper-2 (skill test) have been published separately on the board's website. Candidates are asked to take note of them.
  • Document verification schedule for eligible candidates is also published separately. Check it on the official website.
  • One candidate has been debarred. The board states that a candidate was caught using unfair means in Paper-1, was given an opportunity of defence as per rules, and was then debarred from this recruitment process with the candidature cancelled.
  • Some candidates show 0 marks in Paper-2 in the list. The notice does not explain the reason, so no assumption should be made. Candidates with a doubt should contact the board through official channels.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the written result of the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026. The result was published on 09/10/2026 as a PDF on the official website, upsc.gov.in. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the list have qualified for the SSB interview stage.

The written exam was held on 13 September 2026 under Advt. No. 10/2026-NDA-II for 394 vacancies across the Army, Navy and Air Force wings of the NDA and the 10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme of the Naval Academy. A name wise result PDF link is also listed on the UPSC website.

Yes. UPSC declared the written result on 09/10/2026. The result is a PDF, and candidates do not need to log in to open it. Check your roll number in the list. If it is there, you have qualified in the written examination and move to the SSB interview stage.

How to Check UPSC NDA 2 Result 2026 Name Wise

  1. Go to the official UPSC website, upsc.gov.in.
  2. Open the What's New or Examinations section on the homepage.
  3. Click the link titled Written Result – National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026.
  4. Open the PDF. The list has candidates' roll numbers.
  5. Press Ctrl + F (Cmd + F on Mac) and type your roll number or name to find your entry.
  6. Save and print the PDF for your records.

Also Read: UCO Bank Apprentice Syllabus 2026

What to Do After the NDA 2 Written Result

If your roll number is in the list, take these steps without delay.

  1. Register online on the Indian Army recruitment website, joinindianarmy.nic.in, for the SSB interview. Read the official press note for the exact deadline and procedure.
  2. Wait for your SSB selection centre and interview date, which are allotted after registration.
  3. Prepare your original documents and certificates for the SSB stage and the stages after it.

UPSC NDA 2 2026 Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Two papers, Mathematics and General Ability Test (the provisional answer keys were published for both). 
  • SSB Interview: Services Selection Board tests and interview for candidates who qualify in the written exam.
  • Medical Examination: Candidates who clear the SSB stage undergo a medical examination as per the notification.

NDA 2 2026 Eligibility and Age Limit

  • Army Wing: Passed or appearing in 10+2 (any stream) from a recognised board.
  • Air Force and Naval Wings: Passed or appearing in 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
  • Naval Academy (10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme): Eligibility as per the official notification.
  • Age Limit: Date of birth between 2008 and 01/01/2011. 

Application Fee

Category Fee
General / OBC Rs. 100
SC / ST Rs. 0 (Nil)
Women Rs. 0 (Nil)

Important Instructions for Qualified Candidates

  • The written result is provisional. Final selection depends on the SSB interview, the medical examination and verification of documents.
  • Check the name, roll number and exam details carefully when you find your entry.
  • Use only the official UPSC website and the Indian Army recruitment website for registration. UPSC does not ask for money to include a name in the result.
  • If you notice a problem with your result entry, contact UPSC through the contact details on its website.

How to Check SBI SO Result 2026

Follow these steps to check your qualifying status in the SBI SO Law Officer result.

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Open the Careers section from the homepage.
  3. Find the Recruitment Results or Current Openings notices for Assistant Manager (Law) and Deputy Manager (Law).
  4. Click the link for the list of candidates provisionally selected for interview for your post: Assistant Manager (Law) JMGS-I or Deputy Manager (Law) MMGS-II.

SBI SO Law Officer Selection Process

The selection process has two stages.

  1. Online Written Test: The merit list for this stage is prepared on the combined score of the objective test and the descriptive test. The descriptive test carries 50 marks, with 5 questions to be answered out of 8 in 45 minutes.
  2. Interview: An adequate number of candidates, category-wise, are called based on written test performance. The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.

Deputy Manager (Law), MMGS-II Rs 64,820 - 2340 (1) - 67,160 - 2680 (10) - 93,960 Rs 64,820

What After SBI SO Law Officer Result 2026?

Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview round. SBI will share the interview schedule, venue and call letter through the official website. Until then, candidates should:

  • Check the Careers and Recruitment Results pages of sbi.bank.in regularly.
  • Keep their registration number and login details safe for downloading the call letter.
  • Prepare for the interview, which carries 30% weightage in the final merit.

Documents to Keep Ready for the Interview Stage

SBI has not yet released an official document checklist for this stage. The list below is indicative, so follow the call letter once it is issued.

  • Interview call letter (when released)
  • Valid photo identity proof
  • Law degree certificate and mark sheets
  • Bar Council enrolment certificate
  • Experience certificates as an advocate or Law Officer, as applicable to the post
  • Category or PwBD certificate, if claiming reservation or relaxation
  • Recent passport-size photographs

How to Check RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website, rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities Portal at opportunities.rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section and open "Current Vacancies" → "Results".
  3. Click on the link for the RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026 (Panel Year 2025).
  4. Download the result PDF to your device.
  5. Open the PDF and press Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  6. If your roll number appears in the list, you have qualified for the Language Proficiency Test.

What After RBI Assistant Mains Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the Mains Result must now appear for the Language Proficiency Test (LPT), the final stage of the RBI Assistant selection process. The LPT tests a candidate's ability to read, write, speak, and understand the official/local language of the RBI office for which they applied. Candidates who studied the relevant local language up to the 10th or 12th standard are generally exempted; others must appear for and clear the LPT to remain in contention for final selection. The LPT is qualifying in nature no marks from it are added to the final merit list, but clearing it is mandatory. RBI is yet to announce the exact LPT schedule, venue, and reporting-time details for this cycle; candidates should watch the official portal for this notification.

RBI Assistant Selection Process 2026

  • Preliminary Examination: Qualifying stage only. Prelims marks are not counted towards the final merit list.
  • Main Examination: The Mains score is what decides a candidate's final rank and selection.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Qualifying stage. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the local/regional language of the RBI office applied for. There is no interview stage in this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.co.in and go to the Careers section.

Important Instructions for SBI PO Score Card 2026

The Mains exam includes both an objective test and a descriptive paper, with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applicable to the objective section only. How to Download IBPS PO Mains Admit Card 2026?

Follow these steps to download your IBPS PO Mains call letter online:

  1. Visit the official IBPS website, ibps.in, or use the direct link given above.
  2. Click on "CRP-PO/MT" on the homepage.
  3. Select "Recruitment Process for Probationary Officer CRP PO/MT CRP-XVI".

Forgot Registration Number or Password?

If you have misplaced your registration number or password, you can retrieve it using the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website, ibps.in.
  2. On the login page, click on the PO/MT examination admit card link.
  3. Click on the "Forgot Password?" button.
  4. Enter your registration number along with your registered mobile number or email ID.
  5. Click submit a new password will be sent to your registered email.

Important Instructions for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must follow these exam-day guidelines carefully:

  • Carry a printed copy of the IBPS PO Mains Admit Card along with an original valid photo ID proof.
  • Reach the exam centre at least 30 to 45 minutes before the reporting time mentioned on the call letter.
  • Carry 2 to 3 passport-size photographs identical to the one uploaded on the call letter.
  • Electronic devices, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, and study materials are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at the exam centre to maintain the integrity of the process.
  • Ensure the photograph and signature printed on the admit card are clear and legible.
  • Scribe-related documents are required only for candidates using a registered scribe under PwBD guidelines.

Documents Required for the IBPS PO Mains Exam

Candidates must carry the following mandatory documents to the exam centre:

  • Printed IBPS PO Mains Call Letter / Admit Card
  • Original photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card/e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport), along with a photocopy
  • 2 to 3 extra passport-size photographs matching the one on the call letter
  • Scribe-related documents, only if applicable

  • Father's/Mother's or Husband's Name
  • Date of Birth, Gender, and Category
  • Roll Number/User ID and Registration Number
  • Post Applied (CRP PO/MT CRP-XVI)
  • Exam Date, Stage, and Shift Timing
  • Name, Code, and Complete Address of the Exam Centre
  • Reporting Time and Gate-Closing Instructions
  • Space for candidate's signature and left thumb impression
  • Exam-day rules and instructions

What to Do in Case of an Error on the Admit Card?

If you notice any mistake or discrepancy on your IBPS PO Mains Admit Card, follow these steps:

  1. Verify your name spelling, date of birth, registration number, and category carefully.
  2. Check whether your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the centre name, shift timing, and full address are correct.
  4. Contact the IBPS helpdesk through the official support email or helpline number given on the portal.
  5. Keep your online application form and registration acknowledgement ready for faster resolution.
  6. Download the corrected admit card once the issue has been updated by IBPS.

IBPS PO Mains Exam Date and Pattern 2026

The IBPS PO Mains exam will be held on 4 October 2026. It is a Computer-Based Test that evaluates candidates on Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language, and Data Analysis & Interpretation, along with a descriptive English Language Writing Test (Essay & Letter). Negative marking applies for wrong answers in the objective sections. Exact sectional timings, marks distribution, and negative-marking ratio are not available in the source material used for this article and should be checked on the admit card and the official notification.

The download link for the SBI Clerk Admit Card 2026 for backlog vacancies is active at sbi.bank.in. After logging in, candidates should verify their personal details, venue address, and shift timings before downloading the hall ticket. It is recommended to print at least 2 to 3 physical copies of the call letter for use throughout the selection process.

How to Download the SBI Clerk Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official website @sbi.bank.in/careers or sbi.bank.in

  3. Locate and click on the link for "Download Call Letter for Junior Associate Exam 2026"
  4. Enter the Application No. / Registration No. and Password, or Date of Birth
  5. Click on the Submit/Login button
  6. The hall ticket will appear on the screen
  7. Check the exam date, centre, reporting time, and personal details
  8. Download the SBI Clerk Admit Card PDF
  9. Take 2 clear printouts for the exam day and future reference

  • 2 recent passport-size photographs, matching the one uploaded in the online application form

The SBI Clerk Prelims exam is conducted in multiple shifts throughout the day. Candidates should check their own admit card for their exact shift and reporting time.

  • Total vacancies: 530 (provisional)
  • Who can apply: Graduates (degree completed on or after 1 April 2022), aged 20–28 years as on 1 October 2026
  • Application start date: 14 October 2026
  • Application last date: 29 October 2026
  • Application mode: Online - register on the NATS portal, then pay the exam fee and submit details via BFSI SSC
  • Stipend: ₹16,650 per month
  • Job location: Bank branches in the State/UT chosen by the candidate

Official Notification PDF: UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

UCO Bank invites online applications from candidates for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended). Candidates can apply for only one State/UT. Selection is through an online objective test conducted by the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India (BFSI SSC), followed by a local language test during document verification and a medical fitness check. Apprentices are trainees, not employees of the Bank, and have no right to employment after training.

Particulars Details

Advertisement Number HO/HRM/RECR/2026-27/COM-02

Age and Eligibility Reckoning Date 1 October 2026

UCO Bank Apprentice Vacancy 2026

A total of 530 apprentice seats are available across 31 States/UTs. The numbers are provisional and may vary with the Bank's actual requirement, and the Bank may allot a training location in any district of the selected State/UT. There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen/Disabled Ex-servicemen, and they are not engaged as apprentices.

UCO Bank Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

UCO Bank Apprentice Qualification

Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The graduation mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2022.

UCO Bank Apprentice Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Nationality: A citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries and Vietnam with the intention of settling in India (the last three categories need an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).
  • Candidates must not have undergone, or be currently undergoing, apprenticeship with UCO Bank or any other organisation, and apprentices terminated by their organisation are not eligible.
  • Candidates with training or job experience of one year or more after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
  • Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding at least one local language of that State/UT. A language test is conducted during document verification; candidates who produce a 10th or 12th mark sheet showing they studied the local language are exempt.
  • Candidates may apply for only one State/UT; multiple applications will be rejected (only the last valid application is considered).

UCO Bank Apprentice Age Limit

The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 1 October 2026 (the maximum applies to Unreserved and EWS candidates).

Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits. Daily training hours are as applicable to the Bank's clerical staff. Transport, hostel or any other residential accommodation is not provided.

The fee is paid online to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link in the application form, between 14 October and 29 October 2026. It is non-refundable under any circumstances, whether or not the candidate attends the test or is shortlisted, and cannot be adjusted against any other selection process.

UCO Bank Apprentice Selection Process

Online Objective Test

The total duration is 60 minutes. The advertisement does not mention negative marking. The minimum qualifying marks out of 100 are 40 for General/EWS and 35 for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD. The merit list is prepared State-wise and category-wise in descending order of marks; ties are broken in favour of the older candidate.

How the Online Test Is Taken

  • Eligible applicants who have paid the fee receive an exam link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the exam.
  • The test is taken from the candidate's own residence, using their own camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone, in isolation from other people (except PwBD candidates).
  • Candidates must display the Aadhaar card they uploaded on the NATS portal as ID proof for image capture.
  • Failure to register for the written test results in disqualification. Responses may be analysed for similarity patterns, and results of candidates whose scores are found not genuine can be withheld.

Local Language Test, Medical Fitness and Wait List

The local language test is held during document verification. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. The Bank may declare a wait list at its discretion to cover non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates.

UCO Bank Apprentice Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

UCO Bank Apprentice Apply Online

Applications are accepted online only; no hard copy of the application or documents is to be sent to the Bank. The process is:

  1. Register on NATS: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal (nats.education.gov.in, "Student Register/Login") and note your Enrolment ID.
  2. Apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship: After logging in, view the "UCO Bank" apprenticeship advertisement and apply for it on the portal, choosing one State/UT.
  3. Check your email from BFSI SSC: Candidates who applied on NATS receive an email from BFSI SSC ([email protected]) inviting them to provide caste category, choice of districts for training, and other details, and to pay the fee.
  4. Complete details and pay the fee: Submit the additional information and pay the online fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026. Details entered must match those on the NATS portal.
  5. Upload documents: Upload the photograph, signature, date of birth proof, graduation certificates and other certificates as required by the apprenticeship portal or when advised by the Bank or BFSI SSC.
  6. Appear for the online test: Take the test on 7 November 2026 using the link sent by email.

The candidate's name must be spelt exactly as in the certificates/mark sheets, percentage should be given to two decimals (CGPA must be converted to percentage), and no change is allowed after submission.

UCO Bank Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the engagement process is complete; call letters and intimations are sent by email/SMS only.
  • Original certificates for educational qualification, age and category must be produced at document verification, or candidature is cancelled.
  • OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026; EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26); PwBD candidates need a disability certificate (UDID/certificates may be verified, and a medical board may reassess).
  • Apprentices are trainees, not employees; PF, ESI, bonus and other labour-law provisions do not apply, they may not join or form a union, and the Bank has no obligation to offer employment after training.
  • Candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship before training begins; those who absent themselves may have to refund training costs and stipend received.
  • Travel costs for document verification are borne by the candidate. Requests for changes of contact details, address, email or test centre are not entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. All disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Courts at Kolkata.
  • All revisions and corrigenda will be published only on www.uco.bank.in (career section).

Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026: The Indian Army has invited online applications for 90 provisional vacancies under the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES-57), with training scheduled to begin in July 2027. This entry offers unmarried male candidates who have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics an opportunity to become commissioned Army officers. Candidates must have secured at least 60% aggregate marks in PCM and appeared in JEE Main 2026. Online applications are open from 14 October to 12 November 2026, closing at 12:00 noon.

Unlike a regular soldier recruitment, Indian Army TES 57 provides a four-year military and engineering training programme leading to a Permanent Commission in the rank of Lieutenant. Eligible applicants must have been born between 1 January 2008 and 1 January 2011, both dates inclusive. Shortlisting is based on JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List (CRL), followed by a five-day SSB interview and medical examination. Candidates receive a stipend of Rs. 56,100 per month during the IMA training phase only, followed by Level 10 officer pay after successful commissioning.

Official Website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Important: The 90 vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease according to organizational and training requirements. The recruitment is for Permanent Commission through officer training, not direct appointment as a Lieutenant.

Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Online registration for Indian Army TES 57 begins on 14 October 2026 at 12:00 noon. Candidates must complete the application by 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon. The SSB interview process is tentatively scheduled for February–March 2027.

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 14 October 2026 (12:00 Noon)
Online Application Last Date 12 November 2026 (12:00 Noon)
Expected Shortlisting Cut-off Publication Fourth Week of November 2026 (Tentative)
Expected SSB Interview Period February–March 2027 (Tentative)
Course Commencement July 2027

The actual SSB interview dates, selection centre details and reporting instructions will be communicated through the Indian Army recruitment system.

Indian Army TES 57 Vacancy 2026

The Indian Army has announced 90 provisional vacancies for the 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57. Selected candidates will undergo engineering and military training before being considered for Permanent Commission in the Army.

Entry Vacancies Course
10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES-57) 90 July 2027
Total 90  

The number of vacancies is subject to change based on the training capacity of Cadets Training Wings and the Indian Army's requirements.

Indian Army TES 57 Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, secured at least 60% aggregate marks in these three subjects and appeared in JEE Main 2026. The entry is open to unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality, age and medical standards.

Indian Army TES 57 Educational Qualification

  • Must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized education board.
  • Must have studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM).
  • Must have secured a minimum aggregate of 60% marks in PCM.
  • The PCM percentage is calculated using Class 12 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
  • Must have appeared in JEE Main 2026.

Is JEE Main 2026 Mandatory for Indian Army TES 57?

Yes. Appearing in JEE Main 2026 is mandatory for TES-57. The Indian Army will shortlist eligible applicants using the JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List (CRL). Meeting the Class 12 PCM percentage requirement alone does not guarantee an SSB interview call.

How Are 60% PCM Marks Calculated for Indian Army TES 57?

The 60% requirement applies to the aggregate marks obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in Class 12. Candidates must enter their actual PCM percentage up to two decimal places without rounding it off.

Indian Army TES 57 Nationality Requirements

The notification allows unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality requirements, including:

  • Citizens of India.
  • Subjects of Nepal.
  • Eligible persons of Indian origin who migrated from the countries listed in the notification with the intention of permanently settling in India.

Certain candidates require a Government of India eligibility certificate. The notification provides an exemption from this certificate requirement for Gorkha subjects of Nepal.

Indian Army TES 57 Marital Status Requirement

The entry is restricted to unmarried male candidates. Selected candidates must undertake not to marry until they complete the training programme.

A candidate who marries after applying will not be selected for training, even if successful in the selection process. Marriage during training can lead to discharge and recovery of the prescribed training expenditure.

Indian Army TES 57 Age Limit 2026

The age limit for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 is 16 years 6 months to 19 years 6 months as on 1 July 2027. Candidates must have been born between 1 January 2008 and 1 January 2011, with both dates included.

Particulars Age Requirement
Minimum Age 16 Years 6 Months
Maximum Age 19 Years 6 Months
Age Calculation Date 01 July 2027
Earliest Eligible Date of Birth 01 January 2008
Latest Eligible Date of Birth 01 January 2011

Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or Class 10 certificate, or the accepted equivalent certificate, will be used. Changes to the recorded date of birth are not permitted.

Indian Army TES 57 Selection Process 2026

Selection for Indian Army TES 57 begins with shortlisting based on JEE Main 2026 CRL, followed by the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview, medical examination and final merit list. The final merit list is based on SSB marks, subject to medical fitness, eligibility and vacancy availability.

  1. Application Shortlisting: The Indian Army will shortlist applicants based on JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List and the prescribed cut-off.
  2. SSB Interview: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a five-day SSB assessment.
  3. Medical Examination: Candidates recommended by the SSB will undergo a medical examination at a military hospital.
  4. Final Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the SSB interview.
  5. Joining Letter: Medically fit candidates will receive joining instructions according to merit, eligibility and available vacancies.

Indian Army TES 57 SSB Interview 2027

The TES-57 SSB interviews are tentatively expected between February and March 2027. The SSB assessment is conducted over five days and consists of two stages. Candidates who do not clear Stage I are sent back on the same day.

The SSB assessment includes evaluation by psychologists, Group Testing Officers and Interviewing Officers.

Indian Army TES 57 SSB Interview Centres

SSB Centre State

Jalandhar Punjab

Selection centre allocation and interview instructions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through the registered email address, SMS and official recruitment system.

How Is the Indian Army TES 57 Final Merit List Prepared?

The TES-57 final merit list is prepared on the basis of SSB marks. Higher academic qualifications, previous performance and NCC background do not provide additional merit-list weightage. Final joining depends on medical fitness, the candidate's merit position, fulfillment of eligibility conditions and available vacancies.

Indian Army TES 57 Training Period 2027

Selected candidates will undergo four years of integrated military and engineering training. The programme consists of three years at a Cadets Training Wing and one year at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun.

Training Phase Duration Training Institution
Phase I 3 Years Cadets Training Wing at CME Pune, MCTE Mhow or MCEME Secunderabad
Phase II 1 Year Indian Military Academy, Dehradun
Total 4 Years  

Indian Army TES 57 Engineering Degree

Candidates who successfully complete the four-year training programme will be awarded an Engineering degree.

Cadets Training Wing Engineering Programme
CME, Pune Civil and Mechanical Engineering
MCTE, Mhow Telecommunication and Information Technology Engineering (Dual Degree)
MCEME, Secunderabad Electronics and Mechanical Engineering

Candidates recommended by the SSB must submit preferences for all three Cadets Training Wings. Final allocation is decided by the Indian Army.

Indian Army TES 57 Salary and Training Stipend 2026

Indian Army TES-57 cadets receive a stipend of Rs. 56,100 per month during their training at the Indian Military Academy after completing the initial three years of training. On successful commissioning as a Lieutenant, they become eligible for the Level 10 pay scale of Rs. 56,100–1,77,500 and applicable allowances.

Stage Stipend / Salary

IMA Training Phase Rs. 56,100 per month
After Commissioning as Lieutenant Level 10: Rs. 56,100–1,77,500

Estimated Annual CTC Approximately Rs. 17–18 Lakh, as indicated in the notification

The advertised annual CTC is an approximate figure and is not the same as guaranteed monthly take-home salary.

Promotion to higher ranks is subject to the relevant service conditions and selection requirements.

Indian Army TES 57 Physical and Medical Standards

Candidates must meet the Indian Army's medical and physical fitness standards for officer entry. The notification also provides minimum physical fitness standards expected when reporting for training.

2.4 km Run 10 Minutes 30 Seconds

Swimming Knowledge of Basic Swimming Techniques

These are the standards expected on arrival for training. Candidates should separately consult the official medical standards for the selection-stage medical examination.

How to Apply Online for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must apply online through the official Indian Army recruitment portal between 14 October and 12 November 2026. The application window closes at 12:00 noon on the last date.

  1. Visit the official Indian Army recruitment website at https://joinindianarmy.nic.in/.
  2. Open the online application section for 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57.
  3. Read the TES-57 notification and application instructions carefully.
  4. Complete the online application with the required personal and educational details.
  5. Enter the correct date of birth as recorded in the accepted Class 10 certificate.
  6. Enter the actual Class 12 PCM aggregate percentage up to two decimal places without rounding off.
  7. Provide the required JEE Main 2026 application details.
  8. Review all entries and submit the application before the closing deadline.
  9. Retain the submitted application details for further recruitment stages.
  10. After the application window closes, download and print the system-generated application form as instructed.

Important: Candidates should submit only one application. Multiple applications by the same candidate may result in cancellation of candidature.

Indian Army TES 57 Application Correction and Printout Instructions

The Army permits candidates to correct application details before the online application window closes. After the final submission process, changes are not permitted under the notification's instructions.

  • Check and correct all application entries before the deadline.
  • Resubmit the application after making permitted changes.
  • The application printout becomes available approximately 30 minutes after the application window closes.
  • Print two copies of the application form carrying the system-generated roll number.
  • Carry one self-attested copy to the SSB interview and retain the other for personal reference.
  • Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Directorate General of Recruiting.

Indian Army TES 57 Documents Required for SSB Interview

Shortlisted candidates must carry the required documents for verification at the SSB interview. The notification specifies original certificates and self-attested photocopies.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Directorate General of Quality Assurance, Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores) (DGQA) has announced 32 vacancies for Technician (Skilled) (11 posts) and Technician (Semi Skilled) (21 posts) under advertisement number CGA (GS)/2026/1. The notified pay ranges from Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 to 56,900) to Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 to 63,200) depending on the post. Eligible candidates can apply offline from 17 October 2026 until the last date of 6 December 2026 by sending the completed application form through Ordinary, Speed, or Registered Post. The selection process consists of a Written Test followed by a Trade Test. Candidates with night blindness or colour blindness are not eligible to apply.

DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 Overview

The notification describes this as direct recruitment to Group 'C' Non-Ministerial Industrial posts in the Directorate General of Quality Assurance. Selected candidates are placed on probation, and the pay is fixed as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

Recruiting office Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), Kanpur
Advertisement No. CQA (GS)/2026/1

Posting stations Kanpur (UP), New Delhi, Shahjahanpur (UP)
Pay Technician (Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-2; Technician (Semi Skilled): Pay Matrix Level-1 (7th CPC)
Application mode Offline (ordinary post / Speed Post)

Selection stages Written Test and Trade Test

Abbreviations used in the notification: DGQA - Directorate General of Quality Assurance; DC - Departmental Candidate; ESM - Ex-Serviceman; EWS - Economically Weaker Section; ITI - Industrial Training Institute; NOC - No Objection Certificate; OBC - Other Backward Classes; PwBD - Person with Benchmark Disability; SC - Scheduled Caste; ST - Scheduled Tribe; UR - Unreserved.

The DGQA Technician Vacancy 2026 covers 32 posts across seven establishments. The tables below show the unit-wise and category-wise distribution exactly as given in the notification. A dash in the notification means no vacancy in that category.

Posting Stations and Terms

  • Selected candidates are initially appointed on probation for a period of two years at Kanpur (UP), New Delhi or Shahjahanpur (UP).
  • They are liable to serve anywhere within the limits of the Union of India, including field locations or remote areas, as and when required, as per extant Government of India rules.
  • Each candidate can submit only one application indicating a specific Trade and Station. If a candidate submits more than one application, all applications submitted by the candidate will be summarily rejected without assigning any cause.
  • No change in post or posting station will be permitted after submission of the application.
  • DGQA reserves the right to post the candidate anywhere in India upon organisational requirement or by order of merit.

DGQA Technician Important Dates

The notification does not give separate calendar dates for the opening and closing of applications. It links the closing date to the date of publication in Employment News.

Applications received after the due date, even if delayed in the post, will be rejected summarily and no correspondence will be entertained.

DGQA Technician Eligibility Criteria

The DGQA Technician eligibility conditions cover nationality, qualification, age, service-related conditions, disqualifications and medical fitness. Candidates should read each condition carefully because the notification sets specific requirements for each post and category.

Nationality

Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

Disqualification

No person is eligible for appointment who:

  • has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or
  • having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, provided that the Government may exempt any person from this rule if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for doing so; or
  • is convicted or under trial for associating with criminal offences.

Medical Fitness

  • Candidates must be in good mental and physical health and free from any physical deformity that may interfere with the efficient discharge of duties.
  • Provisionally shortlisted candidates will have to undergo a medical examination prescribed by the Competent Authority (Government Hospital) before an offer of appointment is issued. A candidate found unfit will not be offered an appointment.
  • Candidates diagnosed with night blindness or colour blindness, as determined by the prescribed medical authority, will be declared medically unfit for appointment to the post. They will not be considered for selection or offered appointment, irrespective of their performance at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The decision of the designated Medical Board / Medical Officer regarding such visual defects is final and binding.

Category Certificates and Provisional Candidature

  • Candidature in a reserved category remains provisional until the veracity of the supporting documents is ascertained by the authority.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/EWS/OBC/PwBD must enclose the latest copy of the caste certificate or other relevant certificate issued by a Competent Authority.
  • The benefit of reservation under EWS is applicable upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate as per Annexure - IV issued by a Competent Authority.

The notification names the following as authorities who can issue the caste certificate:

  • Chief Metropolitan Magistrate / Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate / Metropolitan Magistrate.
  • Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar and Sub-Divisional Officer of the area where the candidate and his/her family resides.
  • District Magistrate / Additional District Magistrate / Collector / Deputy Collector / Commissioner / Deputy Commissioner / Additional Deputy Commissioner / First Class Stipendiary Magistrate / Sub Divisional Magistrate / Taluka Magistrate / Executive Magistrate / Extra Assistant Commissioner (not below the rank of First Class Stipendiary Magistrate).

Conditions for ESM / Agniveer Candidates

  • ESM / Agniveer candidates must submit a copy of the e-PPO or Discharge Certificate.
  • They must also enclose a necessary equivalency certificate issued by Competent Authorities whenever the qualification acquired by them is different from the Essential Qualification of the post advertised and applied for.
  • An ESM / Agniveer who has already secured employment in any institution under the Central Government or a State Government in Group 'C' and 'D' posts on a regular basis under the reservation quota for ESM / Agniveer at the time of applying for the post against this advertisement is not eligible for reservation in the ESM / Agniveer category.
  • If an ESM / Agniveer secures such employment on a regular basis under the reservation quota after submitting the application against this advertisement, he/she must give a self-declaration / undertaking to the concerned employer about the date-wise details of the application against this advertisement. The acknowledgement copy of this declaration / undertaking, along with an NOC from the employer and the self-declaration as per Annexure - III, must be produced during document verification, failing which the candidature will stand cancelled.

Conditions for Central Government Civilian Employees

Central Government civilian employees claiming age relaxation must hold a certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure - I) from their office, showing continuous service of not less than three years on the closing date for receipt of applications. They should continue to have the status of Central Government civilian employees from the date of application until the time of appointment, if selected.

DGQA Technician Qualification

The DGQA Technician qualification differs for the two posts. Eligible candidates must also qualify a departmental Trade Skill Test in the trade of the post for which they are being considered for appointment.

Technician (Skilled) - Essential Qualification

  • Matriculation (10th class pass) from a recognised Board or equivalent.
  • ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade, or its equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course approved as such by the Central Government or State Governments.
  • One year experience in the specified trade from a recognised Organisation or Undertaking.
  • Qualifying the departmental Trade Skill Test in the trade of the post.

Trades specified for Technician (Skilled): Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Painter, Pattern Maker, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture).

Technician (Semi Skilled) - Essential Qualification

  • ITI Pass Certificate in the specified trade, or its equivalent Defence Services Tradesman Course approved as such by the Central Government or State Governments.
  • Qualifying the departmental Trade Skill Test in the trade of the post.

Trades specified for Technician (Semi Skilled): Book Binder, Carpenter, Computer Hardware and Networking, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Cutting & Sewing, Electrician, Fitter, Information Technology and Electronic System Maintenance, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Painter, Plumber, Refrigeration and Air conditioner Mechanic, Tool and Die Maker or Tools and Die (Jig and Fixture).

The notification text for Technician (Semi Skilled) lists the ITI certificate and Trade Skill Test as essential qualifications. A separate matriculation requirement and a work-experience requirement are not listed for this post.

The crucial date for determining the maximum age limit is the closing date for receipt of applications from candidates in India, and not the extended closing date prescribed for the specified regions.

DGQA Technician Application Fee

The notification does not specify any application fee or exam fee for the DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026. Candidates must, however, submit a self-addressed envelope of size 30 cms x 12 cms affixed with a postal stamp of Rs 60/- along with the application, for sending the admit card. This is a postage requirement mentioned in the notification, not an application fee.

DGQA Technician Salary

The pay and emoluments are as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

 
Post Pay Matrix level Pay range
Technician (Skilled) Level-2 Rs. 19,900 to 63,200
Technician (Semi Skilled) Level-1 Rs. 18,000 to 56,900

Recruited candidates will draw salary according to the said pay level and will be entitled to other applicable benefits and allowances. They will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS) / Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as per extant Government of India rules.

DGQA Technician Selection Process

The selection process has two stages: a Written Test and a Trade Test. A merit list is then prepared, and final appointment depends on document verification, medical examination and verification of character and antecedents.

Written Test

  • Eligible candidates have to appear in the Written Test, which will be conducted in one session, either in the forenoon or afternoon of the day.
  • The test is of objective type with multiple choice questions only. There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The examination will be conducted in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. The exact date, time and venue will be mentioned in the Admit Card.
  • The question papers will be as per the syllabus in Tenth Standard / Matriculation of Central / State Boards.
  • The question paper is in three parts. Part (i) is in English and Hindi; Parts (ii) and (iii) are in English only.
 
Part Subject Questions Marks
(i) General Awareness 30 30
(ii) English Language and Comprehension 30 30
(iii) Numerical Aptitude 40 40
Total (sum of the three parts) 100 100

Shortlisting and Trade Test

Candidates are shortlisted after the Written Test based on marks obtained and the category of reservation. Candidates shortlisted on the basis of the Written Test will be called for the Trade Test. The names of shortlisted candidates will be published either on the same day or the next day of the Written Test, and the Trade Test will be conducted after shortlisting.

Merit List and Tie-Breaking

After the Written Test and Trade Test, a merit list is prepared on the basis of marks obtained. If more than one candidate secures equal marks (trade-cum-station wise), the tie is resolved in the following sequence:

  1. Date of birth, with the older candidate placed higher.
  2. Candidate with higher marks in Numerical Aptitude.
  3. Candidate with higher marks in English Language and Comprehension.

Final Selection and Appointment

  • Selected candidates will be informed of their provisional selection after completion of the selection process, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained before that.
  • Success in the Written Test and Trade Test confers no right of appointment unless the Government is satisfied, after such enquiry as may be considered necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all respects for the service or post.
  • The appointment letter will be strictly based on the veracity of the documents submitted with the application, including supporting documents for eligibility criteria and the reserved category certificate (not applicable for UR candidates), as well as the Medical Examination Report, Verification of Character and Antecedents, and any other requirement mentioned in the application and specified by the Government of India.

How to Apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026

Applications for this recruitment are to be sent by post. Follow the steps below as given in the notification.

  1. Prepare the application in the prescribed format (Appendix 'A'), typed in English on A4 size paper.
  2. Prepare two Admit Cards as per Appendix 'B' on A4 size paper.
  3. Arrange all documents listed in the section below, with self-attested copies where required.
  4. Superscribe the envelope clearly with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SKILLED)" or "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TECHNICIAN (SEMI SKILLED)".
  5. Send the application only by ordinary post or Speed Post to the address given below so that it reaches before the closing date.

Address for Sending the Application

The Controller,
Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores),
DGQA Stores Complex, Ashok Path, Meerpur Cantt,
Kanpur - 208004, Uttar Pradesh

Documents Required with the Application

  • Application Form, duly completed on the prescribed format as per Appendix 'A', typed in English on A4 size paper.
  • Two (02) Admit Cards as per Appendix 'B' on A4 size paper.
  • One (01) self-addressed envelope of size 30 cms x 12 cms affixed with a postal stamp of Rs 60/-, for sending the admit card to eligible candidates for the written test. The applicant must ensure the address is correct and legible; the organisation will not be responsible for non-receipt of the admit card due to wrong or incorrect postal address, and no overwriting on the admit card address is permitted.
  • Three (03) recent passport size photographs - one affixed in the appropriate box on the Application Form and two others, self-signed, affixed in the appropriate box on each of the two Admit Cards. Additional photographs are to be provided as per the Appendix and Annexure.
  • NOC, for candidates working in Government Service or a Public Sector Undertaking. Such candidates must forward the application through proper channel along with a certificate from the Head of Office / Establishment that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against them and that there is no objection to releasing them in case of selection. An application not accompanied by an NOC will be summarily rejected without any communication.
  • Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card.
  • Experience Certificate, if applicable.
  • Self-attested copy of Birth Certificate.
  • Self-attested copies of Technical Qualification.
  • Self-attested copies of Educational Qualification.
  • Self-attested copy of Caste certificate (OBC / SC / ST), if applicable.

  • Self-attested copy of EWS certificate issued by the Competent Authority, if applicable.
  • Self-attested copy of OBC certificate issued by the Competent Authority, if applicable (Annexure - II).
  • Self-attested copy of e-PPO / Discharge certificate for ESM / Agniveer, if applicable.

Application Closing Date

The closing date for receipt of applications is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. For candidates residing in the areas listed in the Important Dates section, it is 28 days from the date of publication.

Format of Application (Appendix 'A')

The application should be neatly typed on A4 size paper using Arial font, size 12. Overwriting, crossing-out or use of correction fluid is strictly prohibited. The choice on 'Yes/No' items must be indicated by placing a tick mark. The application must be printed double-sided (back-to-back), and the applicant must affix his/her signature to every page. The format asks for the following details, with a recent coloured self-attested passport size photograph of the applicant:

  1. Name of the post applied for.
  2. Name of the candidate (in block letters).
  3. Father's / Husband's name.
  4. Whether belonging to UR / SC / ST / OBC / PwBD / EWS / ESM / Agniveer (attach the necessary certificate issued by the competent authority / CMO).
  5. Date of birth (in Christian era); age as on closing date; whether age relaxation is claimed (Yes/No) and, if yes, the reason for age relaxation.
  6. Nationality.
  7. Gender (Male / Female).
  8. Aadhaar Number.
  9. Educational qualification, beginning from Matriculation or equivalent: exam passed, university / board of examination, year, subject, division and percentage of marks.
  10. Professional / technical qualification, if any.
  11. Experience, if any, showing last pay drawn: post held, name of establishment, from, to, last pay drawn and description of work.
  12. Present postal address for communication.
  13. Permanent address.
  14. Any other additional information.
  15. Phone number or mobile number and alternate number.
  16. Email ID.
  17. Details of immediate family members or blood relatives currently working in the DGQA organisation, if any (name, relationship and post).
  18. Whether convicted by a Court of Law, or whether any criminal or civil case of moral turpitude is pending against the applicant in any court of law in India or abroad.
  19. Whether employed in a Central / State Government Institution.
  20. Whether subject to any departmental inquiry, disciplinary proceedings or suspension during previous employment, or whether any such inquiry is pending.
  21. Whether dismissed, removed, or asked to resign from any position.

The application also carries a declaration. The candidate declares that the information is complete and correct, that any false or incorrect information or missing enclosure found before or after the test/interview or at a later stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and forfeiture of claims, and that he/she is aware of and accepts liability to serve anywhere within territorial limits of the Union of India, including field locations or remote areas, as and when required, as per extant Government of India rules. The form also has spaces for place, date, left thumb impression (men) or right thumb impression (women), signature, and a list of enclosures (refer to the documents clause of the advertisement).

Admit Card Format (Appendix 'B')

The Admit Card is prepared on a separate sheet of paper in double sheet (submitted in duplicate). It carries Advertisement No. CQA (GS)/2026/1 and Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), Kanpur 208004. Items 1, 2, 3 and 4 are to be filled by the candidate; items 5 to 7 are for office use.

  • Name (in block letters).
  • Father's / Husband's name.
  • Full address for correspondence with PIN code.
  • Aadhaar Number.
  • Email ID.
  • Post applied for - Technician (Semi Skilled) / Technician (Skilled), ITI trade, and establishment.
  • For office use only: roll number, date of test, time of test and venue of test.

The Admit Card carries an undertaking that the candidate has read the instructions for examination and is aware that any violation of instruction or misconduct will lead to summary cancellation of the candidature. It also requires a recent coloured self-attested passport size photograph, left thumb impression (men) or right thumb impression (women), and the signature of the applicant. The notification notes that all documents and certificates in original regarding date of birth, category, qualifications and experience must be produced at the time of document verification, failing which the candidature stands cancelled.

Instructions for Examination (Appendix 'C')

  • Candidates will be allowed to take the examination at the centre specified in the Admit Card only and at no other centre. They are advised to report at the examination centre one hour before the commencement of the examination.
  • No candidate will be admitted to the examination unless he/she holds a valid Admit Card, and no candidate will be admitted to the examination hall after the commencement of the examination.
  • The candidate should not bring any other paper except the Admit Card to the examination hall.
  • No candidate will be allowed to leave the examination hall before expiry or the prescribed time of the paper.
  • The use of calculating devices including logarithm-table, calculator or electronic gadgets such as mobile phone is not allowed inside the examination hall.
  • Candidates must abide by the instructions given by the Supervisor / Invigilator. If any candidate is found obstructing the work of invigilator, his/her candidature will be summarily cancelled.
  • A candidate found in possession of any incriminating articles or materials such as reading materials, books, notes and any electronic gadgets such as mobile phones, ear buds, Bluetooth devices, pen-camera, button-hole camera, scanner and so on, whether in use or not, will be deemed to have been using unfair means and is liable to penal action as deemed fit, including cancellation of candidature and debarment from future examinations conducted by the Central Government for a period of three years.
  • Candidates should bring a photo-bearing identity proof in original, such as Voter ID, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card or Aadhaar Card, failing which they will not be allowed to appear in the examination.
  • Candidates have to darken the circle in the answer sheet with a Blue or Black Ball Point Pen in the specified space on OMR sheets while filling in their particulars and answering the questions.

Candidates must sign a declaration stating that they have read and understood the above instructions for compliance.

Annexures Attached to the Notification

  • Annexure - I: Certificate to be submitted by Central Government civilian employees seeking age relaxation. It is filled by the Head of the Office or Department, certifying that the employee holds a post in a stated pay scale with not less than 3 years of regular service in the grade as on the closing date, that there is no objection to the employee appearing for the examination or skill test, and that the individual will be relieved on selection.
  • Annexure - II: Form of certificate to be produced by Other Backward Classes applying for appointment to posts under the Government of India. It certifies the candidate's community, that the candidate does not belong to the persons or sections (Creamy Layer) mentioned in Column 3 of the Schedule to the Government of India, Department of Personnel & Training O.M. No. 36012/22/93-Estt (SCT) dated 8.9.1993 (as amended from time to time), and is issued by the District Magistrate / Deputy Commissioner or equivalent authority with seal.
  • Annexure - III: Undertaking to be given by the candidate who is an Ex-Serviceman / Agniveer. The candidate understands that appointment is subject to documentary evidence of due release, retirement or discharge from the Armed Forces and entitlement to benefits under the Ex-Servicemen Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts rules, 1979, as amended from time to time. The candidate also undertakes not to claim a vacancy reserved for Ex-Servicemen if he/she has, before such appointment, secured civil employment (including Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Statutory Bodies, Nationalised Banks and so on) by availing the benefit admissible to Ex-Servicemen / Agniveer. The candidate gives the date of appointment in the Armed Forces, date of discharge, length of service in the Armed Forces and last unit / corps.
  • Annexure - IV: Certificate to be submitted by an EWS candidate. It certifies that the candidate belongs to the Economically Weaker Section because the gross annual income of his/her family is below Rs 8 Lakh (Rupees Eight Lakh only) for the stated financial year and the family does not own or possess any of the following assets: 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq ft and above; a residential plot of 100 sq yards and above in notified municipal corporation; or a residential plot of 200 sq yards and above in areas other than notified municipal corporation. It also certifies that the candidate belongs to a caste not recognised as Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Classes (Central List). The notes state that income is covered from all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession and so on), that "Family" includes the person seeking the benefit, his/her parents and siblings below 18 years, and his/her spouse and children below 18 years, and that property held by a family in different locations or cities is clubbed while applying the land or property holding test.

DGQA Technician Apply Online

The notification does not provide any online application link or online application portal for the DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted offline by ordinary post or Speed Post to the Controller, Controllerate of Quality Assurance (General Stores), Kanpur. Candidates should not rely on any online link unless it is confirmed in the official notification.

General Instructions, Misconduct and Travel

General Instructions

  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility conditions. Admission to the examination at all stages is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions. If, at any time, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility conditions, the candidature will be cancelled or services terminated, if already appointed.
  • Applications received after the due date (even due to postal delay) will be rejected summarily and no correspondence will be entertained.

The following acts or omissions will render an application disqualified or rejected:

  • Not found to possess the essential qualifications.
  • Furnishing of false, inaccurate, tampered or dubious information.
  • More than one application submitted by a candidate for the same post.
  • Any other deemed irregularity or reason as observed by the Board of Officers.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise.
  • Application not in the prescribed format, or incomplete, unsigned, undated or improperly filled.
  • Tampering of the photo or any other details in the Admit Card at the time of reporting for the Written Test or Trade Test.
  • Application of a candidate working in a Government Establishment not received through proper channel with NOC.
  • Application not accompanied by self-attested copies of prescribed certificates in support of age, qualification, caste, disability, discharge and so on, as applicable.
  • Non-disclosure in the application form of a higher qualification possessed by the candidate, though the essential qualification for the post of Technician (Semi Skilled) and Technician (Skilled) is ITI.
  • Photo in the Application Form and Admit Card not being the same, or the photo having been taken more than one month before submitting the application form against this advertisement.
  • Entries in the application being overwritten or struck. Candidates are advised to avoid overwriting or corrections before forwarding the application, and to preferably type the application form.

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty of Misconduct

A candidate will be summarily cancelled at any stage during or after the recruitment without notice, and no representation will be entertained, if the applicant is found to have indulged in any of the following: impersonation; use of unfair means; canvassing in any form; suppressing material information; making false or incorrect statements; submitting forged or tampered documents; misrepresentation, hiding or falsification of facts; attempting to or causing disruption of the recruitment; misconduct or misbehaviour with recruiting officials; possession of any prohibited item within or in the vicinity of the recruitment venue; misconduct, misbehaviour or causing disturbance within or outside the recruitment premises; resorting to any other irregular or improper means in connection with the candidature for the examination; and malpractices in any form with any plan or attempt to gain or cause unauthorised access to any question paper of the recruitment.

Travel and Accommodation

  • No TA / DA is admissible to candidates for appearing in the Written Test or Trade Test.
  • Candidates will make their own arrangements for lodging and boarding during the Written Test and Trade Test.
  • The recruitment process can be cancelled, postponed, suspended or terminated without notice and without assigning any reasons, at any stage.
