Canara Bank Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

All eligibility conditions, including age and qualification, are computed as on 01.09.2026 (inclusive). The tables below summarise the main conditions.

Canara Bank Apprentice Qualification

 
Educational Qualification A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a university recognized by the Govt. of India, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government.
Graduation Passing Window Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.01.2023 and not later than 01.09.2026 (both days inclusive).
Test of Local Language Candidates who produce a 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/ certificate showing they studied the opted local language will not have to take the local language test. For other candidates, the test will be conducted when they are called for Document Verification. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices.
Physical/ Medical Fitness Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank.
Portal Registration Candidates need a 100% complete profile on https:/ / nats.education.gov.in before applying.

Canara Bank Apprentice Age Limit

The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 01.09.2026. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 02.09.1998 and not later than 01.09.2006 (both days inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General Category and EWS candidates.

 
Sl. No. Category Age Relaxation
1 Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe 5 years
2 Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
3 Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as defined under "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016" 10 years
4 Widows, divorced women and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried Age concession up to the age of 35 years for General/ EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ ST candidates

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

Other Eligibility Conditions and Notes

  1. Age relaxation for SC/ ST/ OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with only one of the remaining categories for which age relaxation is permitted.
  2. Candidates seeking age relaxation must submit the necessary certificate(s) in original along with photocopies at the time of document verification/ reporting for On-the-Job training and at any later stage required by the Bank.
  3. Reservation for PwBD is horizontal and within the overall training vacancies for the State.
  4. No Ex-servicemen/ Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice, and there is no reservation for them in this engagement.
  5. The candidate should not have undergone Apprenticeship Training with Canara Bank or any other organization earlier, should not be pursuing Apprenticeship Training under the Apprentices Act 1961, and should not have been terminated during Apprenticeship Training due to their own fault.
  6. Candidates who have undergone training or have job experience of one or more years after completing their educational qualification are not eligible.
  7. SC/ ST/ OBC/ PwBD candidates need a Caste/ Category Certificate issued by a competent authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India.
  8. OBC candidates need a valid OBC certificate with a non-creamy layer clause. OBC candidates who come under the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation and should indicate their category as General in the online application.

Canara Bank Apprentice Reservation Details

Reservation for SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS/ PwBD candidates is as per the prescribed reservation percentages of the respective States/ UTs as per Government guidelines. Candidates from reserved categories, including those for whom no reservation is mentioned, may apply for unreserved vacancies if they fulfil all eligibility conditions applicable to the unreserved category.

PwBD Reservation

Under section 34 of "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016", persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. The post is identified as suitable for the following disability categories as defined in the Schedule of the RPwD Act 2016.

  • Visual Impairment (VI): Persons with blindness (total absence of sight; visual acuity less than 3/ 60 or less than 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degrees) or low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/ 18 or less than 20/ 60 up to 3/ 60 or up to 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees).
  • Hearing Impaired (HI): Deaf (70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears) or Hard of Hearing (60 DB to 70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears).
  • Orthopedically Challenged/ Locomotor Disability (OC/ LD): Inability to execute distinctive activities associated with movement of self and objects resulting from affliction of the musculoskeletal or nervous system or both, including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism (adult height of 4 feet 10 inches (147 centimeters) or less), Muscular Dystrophy, Acid Attack Victims, Spinal Deformity and Spinal Injury without any associated neurological/ limb dysfunction.
  • Intellectual Disability (ID): Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Specific Learning Disability (SLD) and Mental Illness (MI), as defined in the notification.
  • Multiple Disabilities: Multiple disabilities among the categories above.

Only persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. A benchmark disability means not less than 40% of a specified disability, as certified by the certifying authority. Candidates must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines, which is subject to verification or re-verification at any point. PwBD reservation is not applicable on the basis of a temporary disability certificate. It is only for persons with irreversible permanent benchmark disability in terms of O.M. No. 36035/ 8/ 2023-Estt. (Res-II) dated 19.05.2023 of DoPT. Government guidelines may change from time to time.

EWS Reservation

  • Persons not covered under the reservation schemes for SC, ST and OBC, and whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh, are identified as EWS. Income includes all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year prior to the year of application.
  • Families owning any of these assets are excluded irrespective of income: 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; a residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; a residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than notified municipalities.
  • Property held in different locations or cities is clubbed for the land or property holding test.
  • The EWS benefit requires an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India. Shortlisted candidates must bring it at document verification.
  • "Family" includes the candidate, parents and siblings below 18 years, and the spouse and children below 18 years.

Disclaimer in the notification: EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

Canara Bank Apprentice Stipend and Salary

Apprentices are not employees of Canara Bank. A monthly stipend is paid instead of a salary during the apprenticeship period.

 
Monthly Stipend Rs. 16,650 (including subsidy amount, if any, by Govt. of India)
Paid by Canara Bank Rs. 10,500 per month into the apprentice's account
Government Share Rs. 6,150, credited directly to the apprentice's bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines
Deductions Stipend is paid each month after adjusting loss of pay, if any
Other Allowances/ Benefits Not eligible for any other allowances or benefits

Canara Bank Apprentice Application Fee

The fee is non-refundable and includes GST. It is payable online only.

 
Category Application Fee / Intimation Charges (Non-Refundable)
SC/ ST/ PwBD NIL
All Others Rs. 500 (incl. intimation charges)

Payment can be made by Debit Cards (RuPay/ Visa/ MasterCard/ Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards or Mobile Wallets. An e-receipt is generated after a successful transaction. Candidates should not press Back or Refresh after submitting payment information, to avoid double charge.

Canara Bank Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is merit-based. The notification does not describe a written examination.

  1. Merit list: Prepared state-wise in descending order of marks/ percentage in 12th Std (HSC/ 10+2)/ Diploma Examination. Ties are ranked by age in descending order.
  2. Minimum marks: Not less than 60% (55% for SC/ ST/ PwBD) in 12th Std/ Diploma. Fractions are ignored, so 59.99% is treated as below 60% and 54.99% as below 55%.
  3. Document Verification and local language test: Conducted during the Document Verification process. Original documents are checked. Any discrepancy leads to summary disqualification.
  4. Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility and application information, qualification in the local language test of the opted State where applicable, and being declared medically fit.

Where CGPA/ OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage in the online application, with a certificate from the appropriate authority stating the conversion norms. Percentage is total marks obtained in all subjects in all semesters/ years divided by aggregate maximum marks, multiplied by 100. The merit list is prepared only on the information submitted in the online application.

How to Apply for Canara Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Canara Bank Apprentice Apply Online

  1. Register on https:/ / nats.education.gov.in and complete your profile to 100%. Keep the enrollment number generated.
  2. Visit www.canarabank.bank.in, open Careers, then Recruitment, then the link "Engagement of Graduate Apprentices in Canara Bank under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27".
  3. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic information. A provisional registration number and password are generated and sent by email and SMS. Saved data can be reopened using them.
  4. Enter the NATS enrollment ID, fill all fields, and choose one State along with district preferences.
  5. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as specified below.
  6. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details. No change is possible after clicking FINAL SUBMIT.
  7. Pay the fee online (if applicable), then take a printout of the application and e-receipt.

Apply well before the closing date to avoid website load issues. Only one application should be submitted; if multiple are submitted, only the latest valid completed application is retained.

Documents Required to Apply Online

Upload Specifications
Document Dimensions (preferred) File Size Other Requirements
Photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm) 200 x 230 pixels 20 KB to 50 KB Recent colour passport-style photo on a light background; caps, hats and dark glasses not accepted
Signature 140 x 60 pixels 10 KB to 20 KB Black ink on white paper; CAPITAL LETTERS not accepted
Left thumb impression 240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI (3cm x 3cm) 20 KB to 50 KB jpg/ jpeg; black or blue ink on white paper
Handwritten declaration 800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI (10cm x 5cm) 50 KB to 100 KB jpg/ jpeg; English, black ink, own handwriting, not in CAPITAL LETTERS

The declaration text is: "I, ____ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Candidates without a left thumb may use the right thumb or other alternatives given in the notification, and must mention the finger and hand/ toe used in the uploaded document. Candidates who cannot write may type the declaration and put their left thumb impression below it. Images should be scanned at a minimum of 200 dpi in true colour, in JPG/ JPEG format. Unclear or smudged images may lead to rejection.

Candidates also need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, active until the process ends, and should spell their name as in the SSC/ SSLC/ X Standard marks card (or as per Gazette Notification/ Marriage Certificate if changed). An application that is incomplete or has unsuccessful fee payment is invalid. If no email/ SMS intimation is received, the application is considered not successfully registered.

Documents to Be Produced at the Time of Engagement

Originals with a self-attested photocopy must be submitted, failing which the candidate may not be permitted to join.

  • Valid system-generated printout of the online application.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Executive & Credit Analyst Eligibility Criteria

Preferred: 2-year full-time PG degree/diploma in Management or MBA (Finance/Marketing/Banking). Minimum 2 years of experience in sales of wealth products with leading public/private/foreign banks, broking, securities firms, asset management companies, or wealth management companies in India.
Credit Analyst – C&IC Graduation in any discipline AND Chartered Accountant. Mandatory: minimum 1 year of banking experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. Preferred: experience in Corporate Credit.

Bank of Baroda Selection Process 2026

The selection process may comprise Application Scrutiny, an Online Test, Psychometric Test, Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI), or any other test deemed suitable by the Bank.

  • Sections 1, 2 and 3 are qualifying in nature; marks in these sections are not reckoned for the merit list.

  • Candidates not clearing the PI will not be considered for final selection.

Probation Period & Service Bond

  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in/Career.htm

The Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank), an all-India premier financial institution engaged in financing, facilitating and promoting India's international trade, has invited applications for its Special Recruitment Drive (SRD) for Backlog Vacancies, vide Advertisement No. HRM/DM & M/SRD/2026-27/04.

This Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 8 posts across Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I – Banking Operations) and Manager (Grade/Scale MM II – Internal Audit), against SC, ST, and OBC backlog vacancies. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. The online application link will be live from 15 September 2026 to 21 October 2026, and no other mode of application will be accepted. Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post.

Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) – Internal Audit (2 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent).

Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) – Banking Operations (6 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above.

Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures.

  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet.
  • The university/institute must be recognised/approved by the Government / AICTE / UGC.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process

Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Structure of Written Test

Name of Test Section No. of Questions Max. Marks Time
Professional Knowledge – Subjective Part I – Question 1 (Compulsory) 1 40 2 hours 30 minutes
Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions 6 (of 8) 60
Total 100 2 hours 30 minutes

There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 21 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Documents and Scanned Images Required

Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm, colour, white/light background, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG

  • OBC caste certificates must specifically contain the non-creamy layer clause and must be valid (issued within one year prior to) the last date of applying.
  • Deputy Managers must execute a personal bond of ₹3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or appear in the CIBIL defaulter database are not eligible to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai, with courts/tribunals in Mumbai having sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the recruitment process, including the number of vacancies, at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected may use a scribe at their own cost and arrangement, subject to the Bank's stipulated scribe guidelines, and will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination if registered for it in advance.

Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

IOB SO Exam Date 2026: Official Announcement

The official notice is short. It states that the online examination is tentatively scheduled for 31.10.2026 (Saturday), that admit cards will be made available for download shortly, and that candidates should visit the bank's website regularly for updates.Because the bank uses the word "tentatively", the date can still change. Treat 31 October 2026 as the planned date and re-check iob.bank.in before you travel.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification released 28 August 2026
Online registration and fee payment start 29 August 2026
Last date to apply and pay fee 15 September 2026
Exam date notice released 9 October 2026
Online exam 31 October 2026 (Saturday)

IOB SO Exam Schedule and Shift Timing

The official notice gives only the date and day. Shift timing, reporting time and gate closing time have not been announced and will be printed on the admit card or call letter.

Detail Information
Exam name IOB Generalist / Specialist Officers online examination
Date and day 31 October 2026, Saturday (tentative)
Total duration 2 hours, with separate timing for each section (per the notification)
Exam centres Allotted through the call letter; see the list below

IOB SO Exam Centres

The notification lists six examination centre cities. The bank may add or remove centres, may allot a centre different from the one you chose, and does not accept requests for change of centre.

  1. Delhi / New Delhi / NCR
  2. Mumbai / Navi Mumbai / MMR / Thane
  3. Chennai
  4. Kolkata
  5. Hyderabad
  6. Bengaluru

Age, qualification and experience are calculated as on 1 August 2026. The table below is a summary. Certification requirements and detailed experience conditions differ by post, so check the full notification for the post you applied for.

Negative Marking and Qualifying Marks

  • One-fourth of the marks for a question are deducted for each wrong answer. There is no penalty for an unattempted question.
  • Overall minimum qualifying marks in the online exam: 35% for unreserved candidates and 30% for reserved candidates.
  • No minimum qualifying marks are prescribed for English Language or General Awareness. Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks in Professional Knowledge.

Required Documents

For the Online Exam

  • Printed call letter / admit card.
  • One original photo identity proof from this list: Passport, Aadhaar / e-Aadhaar, PAN Card, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with attested photograph, ID card issued by a school or college, or a Gazetted Officer certificate on official letterhead.
  • A self-attested photocopy of the same ID, to be submitted with the call letter to the invigilator.

A Ration Card is not accepted as ID. If your identity is in doubt or the photocopy is missing, you may not be allowed to appear.

For the Interview Stage (as applicable)

Originals plus self-attested photocopies of the following are required, and candidates may be refused the interview without them:

  • Interview call letter and system-generated printout of the online application.
  • Proof of date of birth (birth certificate or SSLC / Std. X certificate with date of birth).
  • Photo ID proof.
  • Mark sheets and certificates for educational qualifications, and proof of any preferred certifications.
  • Work experience proof: experience certificates, appointment and relieving letters, pay slips.
  • Category certificates: caste certificate (OBC certificate with non-creamy layer clause, valid on the interview date), EWS income and asset certificate, or PwBD disability certificate, as applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates serving in government, quasi-government or public sector organisations, including nationalised banks and financial institutions.
  • Any other relevant documents supporting eligibility.

How to Apply for IOB SO Recruitment 2026

The application window closed on 15 September 2026. The sources reviewed do not mention any reopening or extension. The steps below are from the official notification, for reference.

  1. Visit www.iob.bank.in and open the Careers page.
  2. Open "Recruitment of Generalist / Specialist Officers in Various Scales - 2026 - 27" and select the post.
  3. Click "Click here to Register Online" and complete registration. A registration number and password are sent by email and SMS.
  4. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the specifications.
  5. Fill in the application form and click "Complete Registration".
  6. Pay the application fee online (debit card, credit card, internet banking, BHIM or UPI).
  7. Take a printout of the application form and e-receipt.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Follow only the official website, www.iob.bank.in, for announcements. The bank says all further announcements will be published there.
  • Check your email regularly. The bank is not responsible for late receipt or non-receipt of communication.
  • Your signature at the exam must match the signature uploaded in the application, or you may be disqualified.
  • No request for change of exam centre is entertained, and the bank may allot a centre other than your choice.
  • You travel to the centre at your own risk and expense.
  • Candidates with disabilities who opted for a scribe or compensatory time must have registered for it in the application. Later requests may not be accepted.
  • The bank can change, cancel or add to the selection criteria or method. If the English and a translated version differ, the English version prevails.
  • For queries, the notification lists the email [email protected].

Chhattisgarh State Cooperative Bank Limited Raipur (CG Apex Bank) has notified 1 vacancy for the Co-operative Intern post on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, with posting in Jagdalpur. The position requires an MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri-Business Management, or Rural Development Management, along with mandatory proficiency in computers and a one-year service bond. The pay is Rs. 25,000 per month. Candidates must apply through the offline mode by downloading and filling out the application form, then sending it by Registered or Speed Post to the Managing Director, Chhattisgarh Rajya Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Raipur, Headquarters "Sahakar Bhavan", Plot No.-74 on or before 26 October 2026. Selection involves merit list preparation based on academic marks, document verification, and a medical fitness test.

CG Apex Bank Co-operative Intern at a Glance

Particulars Details
Organisation Chhattisgarh State Cooperative Bank Limited Raipur
Advertisement No. 3614
Post Name(s) Co-operative Intern
Vacancies 1
Pay Rs. 25,000/- per month (consolidated)
Age Limit 21 to 30 years as on 01.01.2026
Job Location Jagdalpur
Application Mode Offline (Registered / Speed Post)
Last Date 26 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM

Vacancy Details

There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Co-operative Intern position located at the District Central Cooperative Bank, Jagdalpur.

Who Can Apply

Candidates must possess an MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri-Business Management, or Rural Development Management. Additionally, computer proficiency is compulsory for all applicants. Candidates must have completed 21 years of age and not be older than 30 years as on 01.01.2026.

Pay and Tenure

Selected interns receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- along with a travelling allowance (TA/DA) as per rules in their respective bank. Interns can take up to 10 days of casual leave in a year, with no other paid leave provided except unpaid medical leave as per applicable bank rules. The appointment is strictly for a period of one year.

How to Apply for CG Apex Bank Co-operative Intern

  1. Download the application form and notification from the official website cgapexbank.com.
  2. Fill out the application form carefully with all required personal and educational details and attach a self-attested passport-size photograph.
  3. Enclose self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar card, high school marksheet, higher secondary marksheet, graduation degree, post-graduation degree, computer qualification certificates, and any other relevant qualification documents.
  4. Write "को-ऑपरेटिव इंटरन की नियुक्ति हेतु आवेदन" in bold letters on the top of the envelope.
  5. Send the completed application by Registered or Speed Post to the Managing Director, Chhattisgarh Rajya Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Raipur, Headquarters "Sahakar Bhavan", Plot No.-74, Sector-24, Atal Nagar, Nawa Raipur (C.G.) 492002 to reach on or before 26 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

Selection and Interview

Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to percentages obtained in High School, Higher Secondary, Graduation, Post-Graduation, and additional qualifications, with academic weightage marks up to a maximum of 50. Selected candidates must undergo document verification and present a medical fitness certificate from a District Hospital Medical Board before joining.

TMB SO IT Recruitment 2026: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB) has released the Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 notification for experienced IT professionals. The recruitment covers positions in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, IT Infrastructure, Software Development, Cloud Administration, Network Security and Oracle Fusion. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official TMB careers portal from 12 October to 25 October 2026.

Candidates with relevant qualifications such as B.E., B.Tech., M.E., MCA or other specified degrees and the required professional experience can apply for the appropriate posts. TMB SO IT Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Tamilnad Mercantile Bank has specified that the application fee for Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 is Nil.

TMB SO IT Selection Process 2026

The selection process for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting of applicants followed by a personal interview.

  1. Application Scrutiny: TMB will examine the submitted applications and supporting documents.
  2. Shortlisting: Eligible applicants will be shortlisted for the selection process.
  3. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will attend an interview conducted directly or through video conferencing.
  4. Interview Communication: The date, time and mode of interview will be communicated individually to eligible candidates.

The bank's decision regarding eligibility, interview and selection will be final.

How to Apply Online for TMB SO IT Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official Tamilnad Mercantile Bank careers portal on or before 25 October 2026.

  1. Visit the official TMB careers website at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/.
  2. Open the recruitment section for Specialist Officer (I.T).
  3. Read the official recruitment advertisement and verify your eligibility.
  4. Click the Apply Online option and register using a valid email address and mobile number.
  5. Activate your account using the registration link sent to your email.
  6. Log in using the registration number or username and password.
  7. Complete the application form with personal, educational and professional details.
  8. Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting certificates in the prescribed format.
  9. Review the information carefully and submit the application.
  10. Keep the system-generated application form for future reference.

TMB SO IT Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload supporting documents with the online application. The bank has specified the following requirements:

Document Requirement
Photograph Preferred dimensions: 390 × 520 pixels; maximum size 120 KB

The uploaded supporting document scans must not exceed 250 KB each. Incomplete applications or applications containing incorrect information may be rejected.

The Railway Recruitment Boards are expected to release the RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026 on 24 October 2026 (24/10/2026) for candidates appearing in the Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) CBT 1 under CEN 01/2026. The exam is scheduled for 3, 4 and 5 November 2026. This date is expected, not officially confirmed. The city intimation slip tells you your allotted exam city and exam date in advance. It is not valid for entry to the exam centre, so you must carry the official admit card (e-call letter) on exam day.

The RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026 is expected on 24 October 2026. Check your regional RRB website for the official activation notice, because the release may be staggered or revised.

  • Enter your registration number and password or date of birth.
  • Enter the captcha code and submit.
  • Your RRB ALP City Intimation Slip 2026 will appear on the screen.

What to Do After Downloading the City Intimation Slip

  • Check your name, exam city and exam date carefully.
  • Plan your travel and stay based on the allotted city and date.
  • Keep your registration number and date of birth ready for the e-call letter.
  • Download the e-call letter once it is released and check the exam centre address on it.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The city intimation slip is not an admit card and cannot be used to enter the exam centre.
  • Carry your official e-call letter to the exam.
  • Reach the centre by the reporting time. Entry is not allowed after the gate closing time.
  • Use only the official RRB website of your region to access the slip and e-call letter.

How to Check Your RRC Prayagraj Group D DV Date and Shift

  1. Open the official DV schedule and cut-off PDF from the link in the Important Links section.
  2. Search for your 16-digit roll number using Ctrl+F on a computer or "Find in page" on a phone.
  3. Note the date and shift listed against your roll number.
  4. Download your E-call letter from www.rrcpryj.org when the link goes live, 5 to 7 days before your DV date.
  5. Print the E-call letter and read all instructions in it.

RRC Prayagraj Group D E-Call Letter

  • The download link will be active on www.rrcpryj.org 5 to 7 days before the DV date.
  • The E-call letter has blank spaces for the self-declaration paragraph, signature and left thumb impression (LTI). Leave them empty and fill them in only at the DV centre in front of the supervisor.
  • Candidates who write the declaration in capital or disjointed letters, or who sign or fill it in beforehand, may have their candidature cancelled.
  • No call letter will be sent by post. Information may also be sent by email and SMS.

Documents Required for RRC Prayagraj Group D Document Verification

Bring the original documents plus two sets of self-attested photocopies in A-4 size.

  1. Printout of the CBT E-call letter (candidate's copy) and the PET E-call letter, where applicable.
  2. One original valid photo ID along with the E-call letter. Accepted IDs: Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, printout of e-Aadhaar, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport, or a valid ID issued by the employer for government employees. Candidates without a photo ID will not be allowed to appear.
  3. Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS). OBC and EWS certificates must be valid on the date of the online application and also currently valid.
  4. Disability certificate and UDID card for candidates with disabilities.
  5. All mark sheets and certificates for educational and technical qualifications.
  6. Twelve coloured passport-size photographs, matching the photo uploaded in the online application.
  7. An affidavit, as per the CEN 08/2024 instructions, if there is any spelling difference in your name or in your parents' names across documents.
  8. Class 10 pass certificate, or ITI / equivalent, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT.
  9. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer for candidates already in service (central or state government, Railways or PSUs, including those on probation or training).
  10. Income certificate (Annexure III-A) for EBC candidates, and a declaration as per Annexure IV for minority candidates claiming the examination fee concession.
  11. Any other certificate or document that is required.

RRC Prayagraj Group D Medical Examination

  • Candidates who clear DV will be sent for the medical examination on the next working day.
  • The medical is held at a designated Railway hospital under North Central Railway: the Divisional Hospital at Prayagraj, Kanpur, Agra or Jhansi.
  • Be prepared to stay for at least 4 days at your own cost.
  • The medical examination fee is Rs. 24, and no other fee is charged.
  • In rare cases where a test such as a CT scan, ultrasound or eye surgery evaluation is needed and not available in the Railway hospital, the candidate must pay the outside laboratory or hospital charges.
  • Carry a valid and current photo ID for the medical.

Also Read: India Post GDS 1st Merit List 2026

Important Instructions for Shortlisted Candidates

  • Shortlisting is not final. Eligibility will be decided only on the basis of the online application details and verification of original documents.
  • If any information is found false or hidden, or if you do not meet the qualification, age, category or medical standards, your candidature will be cancelled and you may be barred from Railway or other government recruitment exams.
  • Being called for DV or receiving an E-call letter does not give any right to a job.
  • The date of birth must match your Class 10 or equivalent certificate. No request to change the date of birth will be accepted, and any mismatch leads to disqualification.
  • Reservation benefits (SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS) need original certificates in the prescribed format: Annexure-I for SC/ST, Annexure-II for OBC-NCL and Annexure-III for EWS.
  • Requests to change the DV centre, date or shift will not be accepted. If you do not appear for DV, your candidature will be cancelled.
  • Biometric details will be taken at every stage. Any discrepancy can lead to disqualification and legal action.
  • Using unfair means or impersonation can lead to a lifetime bar from all RRB/RRC exams and from Railway employment, and service may be terminated if already appointed.
  • RRC may conduct additional DV, cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage, and correct typing or printing errors. The decision of RRC is final.
  • Check www.rrcpryj.org regularly for updates.

Details Not Available in the Official Notice

The notice used for this page does not mention the following details, so they are not covered here:

  • Total number of vacancies for CEN 08/2024
  • CBT exam dates and individual scores
  • Salary or pay amount (the notice only states Level-1 under 7th CPC)
  • Final result or panel date, and posts or zones allotted after DV
  • The outcome or timeline of Writ Petition No. 7985/2026

How to Raise an Objection Against the SSC Selection Post Answer Key

How to Calculate Your Marks Using the Answer Key

Particulars Marks

Correct answer +2
Wrong answer −0.50
Unattempted 0

Formula: Total marks = (Correct answers × 2) − (Wrong answers × 0.50)

Example: A candidate attempts 85 questions, with 70 correct and 15 wrong. Marks = (70 × 2) − (15 × 0.50) = 140 − 7.5 = 132.5.

This is only an estimate. The answer key is tentative, and your score may change if SSC revises any answer after reviewing objections.

  • SSC reviews the valid objections.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.

  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). OR
  • Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) (D.Ed. Special Education) recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) along with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed./BTC).
  • Government Primary School Shiksha Mitras working on an honorarium basis who, with the permission of the State Government, have successfully completed the 2-year D.El.Ed. programme from Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU).
  • Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Primary) and Assistant Teachers/Head Teachers (Upper Primary) serving in all categories of schools allotted a DISE Code and teaching Classes 1 to 5 (in-service teachers).
Upper Primary Teacher
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) along with a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (BTC/D.El.Ed.). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a 1-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed./L.T./Shiksha Shastri) (Regular/Institutional only). OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and a 1-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed./L.T./Shiksha Shastri) (Regular/Institutional only), obtained in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) Regulations issued from time to time. OR
  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). OR
  • Senior Secondary (10+2) or its equivalent with at least 50% marks and a 4-year B.A. B.Ed. / B.Sc. B.Ed. integrated degree. OR
  • Graduation (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. (Special Education) recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). OR
  • Graduation or Post-Graduation with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. However, the minimum percentage requirement at the graduation level shall not apply to candidates who were admitted to the B.Ed., Bachelor of Elementary Education, or equivalent teacher education programme before 29 July 2011. OR
  • In-Service Teachers: Regularly appointed Assistant Teachers, Head Teachers, and Assistant Teachers (L.T.) serving in schools having a DISE Code and teaching Classes VI to VIII (6 to 8) are also eligible.
